articles.title: Coffee, vegetables and exercise share a surprising connection in your gut
articles.description: In a study of 6,803 Japanese adults, researchers identified two opposing gut microbiome patterns linking diet, physical activity, smoking, and alcohol consumption with general health and 15 chronic diseases. Health-oriented microbial patterns were associated with butyrate production and lower inflammation, while disease-oriented patterns were linked to inflammatory processes, with microbiome-based prediction scores showing potential for distinguishing health and disease across international populations.

Tired all the time? What to know about B12 and if it actually boosts energy levels
articles.description: Med spas are raving about vitamin B12 shots as a pick-me-up. But do they actually make you feel more energized? If you spend time on social media, you may have seen med spa owners and employees describing vitamin B12 shots as a pick-me-up. When they’re run down or facing a busy week, they say, a quick injection gets them through. Some med spas say many people feel an energy lift within a day or two and recommend a shot every few weeks. B12 is essential to your health, and people who don’t get enough of it can feel exhausted or worse. But most people already have plenty of B12, and for them, extra doses aren’t likely to help. articles.title: Stronger flu shot linked to nearly 55% lower Alzheimer's risk
articles.description: A surprising new study suggests that a stronger flu shot could offer older adults significantly greater protection against Alzheimer's disease.
